name: Lugath Translate
author: Lugath

sections.description:
What is Lugath

Lugath is a developer-friendly, AI-based translation plugin that allows you to localize your WordPress website effortlessly. With instant translations, SSR-compatible proxy mode, and full REST API access. Even for SPAs, JAMstack sites, and React-based frontends (CRA).

Translate your site globally in seconds

Lugath helps you turn your WordPress website into a multilingual experience — instantly. Whether you’re running a simple blog or a complex, headless architecture with React or CRA, Lugath brings seamless AI translation and real-time rendering to the table.

It’s designed for developers, marketers, and SEO experts alike — combining power and simplicity with clean HTML output and maximum performance.

Why Lugath?

Built for performance
Lugath uses proxy-based translation with zero configuration, rendering translated HTML server-side. This means faster load times, better SEO, and zero layout shifts on load.

SSR + SPA compatible
Works out of the box with modern JavaScript frontends like Create React App (CRA), Next.js, or any SPA setup. Lugath offers REST endpoints for tight frontend integration.

No code required
You don’t have to modify templates or wrap content in special tags. Lugath handles translation on-the-fly using your site’s rendered HTML.

SEO-friendly by design
Every translated page is crawlable and indexable. With clean URLs and proper structure, Lugath helps you rank in every language you speak.

Instant global reach
Don’t settle for a single market. Go global and unlock multilingual traffic using automated translation powered by leading AI providers.

How to Get an API Key

To use Lugath Translate, you need an API key. Follow these steps to obtain your API key:

  1. Go to https://app.lugath.com and create a new account.
  2. In the menu, navigate to the “Website” section and click the “Connect” button.
  3. Enter your website name.
  4. Select WordPress as your website technology
  5. Select the original language of your website.
  6. Choose the target languages you want to translate into.
  7. Enter your website domain.
  8. Once completed, you will see the generated Integration key. Copy it.
  9. Paste the Integration key into the “Lugath” settings in your WordPress admin panel.
  10. Visit your website and check if the language switcher appears in the bottom right corner.
    If the switcher is visible, the script is correctly loaded.

Enabling Server-Side Rendering (SSR)

If you want to enable server-side rendering (SSR):
1. Go to https://app.lugath.com and open your website settings.
2. Navigate to the “General” tab under “Site Settings.”
3. Enable the “Server-Side Rendering” option.
4. Go to “Lugath” settings in your WordPress admin panel.
5. Enable server-side redirection
6. Then select the langauges from Proxy Redirect Language List

Once enabled, translated pages will be stored and served via Lugath’s CDN.
sections.installation:
1. Go to the WordPress admin panel.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP file and activate the plugin.
  4. Go to the “Lugath Translation” section in the admin menu and enter your API key.
sections.faq:
How does the plugin work?

Lugath Translate adds a language switcher and automatically translates content using AI. It integrates with your website via an API key.

Does it support SEO?

Yes! The plugin generates hreflang tags and supports server-side rendering (SSR) to ensure search engines index your translated pages correctly.

Is WooCommerce supported?

Yes, product descriptions, categories, and meta information can be translated automatically.
